title: Privacy and data
description: Choose what Manar may collect to improve the product.
loadError: Could not load your privacy choices.
saveError: Could not save your choice. Try again.
policyIntro: Manar never collects secret values, file contents, prompts or AI replies, keystrokes, screenshots, clipboard, environment variables or full URLs with query strings.

user.title: Your choices
user.description: These apply to your account on every device.

improve.label: Help improve Manar
improve.description: Share product usage, device health and redacted samples of commands and domains Manar asked about or blocked. Turning this off stops collection and deletes your stored samples.

training.label: Use my data to train Manar's AI models
training.description: Allow redacted samples to be used to train and tune Manar's own models.
training.needsImprove: Turn on Help improve Manar to use this.

workspace.title: Workspace choices
workspace.description: These apply to everyone in this workspace. When a switch is off here, it is off for every member.

improve.label: Help improve Manar
improve.description: Allow product data from this workspace to be collected.

training.label: Use workspace data to train Manar's AI models
training.description: Allow redacted samples from this workspace to be used for training.

notice.title: Manar collects product data to improve the service
notice.body: This is usage, device health and redacted samples, never secrets, files or prompts. You can turn it off at any time.
